subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should maintainers retire this stale local-client branch in favor of the current-main SDK 0.19 provider package, or intentionally refresh it as the auth-provider implementation?
rationale: The central audit/auth dependency chain appears fixed on current main, but the PR is protected and still changes auth-provider behavior, provider packaging, and cache-policy handling in ways automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Verify Current Main And Retire Branch
options.body: Confirm the current-main provider package fixes the Node 25+/26 ADC path and close or supersede this PR without merging its stale local client.

options.title: Refresh Local Client Deliberately
options.body: Rebase the branch on current main, add provider-owned dependencies and shrinkwrap, preserve cache-control behavior, and provide live Vertex proof.

options.title: Accept Auth Replacement Risk
options.body: Explicitly choose the local client as the permanent auth-provider shape and own the compatibility difference from the upstream SDK.

recommendation.title: Verify Current Main And Retire Branch
recommendation.body: Confirm the current-main provider package fixes the Node 25+/26 ADC path and close or supersede this PR without merging its stale local client.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the best available routing owner from current-main blame on the provider package/shrinkwrap and prior automerge interaction on this PR.
